direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels very much like a feel-good family movie, as it is very light and playful; The direction on a microscale is genuinely good as it brings out the best in the cast and helps convey the emotions they are feeling as they go through this tragedy; The storytelling is what you would expect from a feel-good family movie, as it is safe but focused; They build tension surprisingly well for a family movie, as you use your emotional connection to the characters to feel the tension

performance.comments: Plays a very lovable character with the screentime he has, acting as sort of a father figure for the flock; Probably the easiest paycheck he has ever had

His accent just feels so wrong for his body and typical characters, but when you get past that, his character is enjoyable because it is basically if Cousin Greg was getting into character for a British detective for an off-Broadway play
Just feels kinda there, plays his role decently well
Plays her role pretty well, is given a very simple and templated role; has pretty good chemistry with the cast

cast.comments: For Voice Cast: they do a good job as they really embody the emotions of the characters and make you feel for them, especially the child actors and ESPECIALLY the winter lamb; For the Supporting Live Action Cast: they do a pretty good job playing characters you would see in a family movie

story.comments: The concept is a whodunit from the perspective of sheep, making the movie feel cute and fun for the whole family; The plot structure is typical for both a family movie and a whodunit; The character writing is the most surprising because the creators do a very good job of building up these characters so that you empathize with their struggle and understand their motives, especially Lily, Sebastian, and especially the Winter Lamb; The character writing for the Winter Lamb is so sad and emotional that you want to give him a hug and tell him he is the best boy as you shed your tears

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is good and well-written, especially for a family movie about sheep; The humor is surprisingly present and good for all ages, making this a well-written movie that is fun for the whole family; The symbolism is surprisingly strong for a family movie about sheep, as the whole movie stems from empathizing with the struggles the sheep face, especially the Winter Lamb; The foreshadowing is somewhat of an issue for the movie because while it is a well-written whodunit, the killer is a bit predictable

score.comments: The score uses themes you would expect from a feel-good family movie to make this a light and fun film

soundtrack.comments: The use of "I'm Gonna Be (500 Miles)" feels right for this movie

cinematography.comments: The cinematography is pretty standard for a higher-budget, feel-good family movie

editing.comments: The editing is pretty standard for a higher-budget, feel-good family movie

sound.comments: The sound is pretty standard for a higher-budget, feel-good family movie

visual_effects.comments: The animal CGI for the sheep is surprisingly good, as it made the animals feel realistic while remaining cute; It definitely feels as though much of the budget went toward the cast and the CGI animals, and it felt worth it

production_design.comments: The film was shot in the UK countryside, which is integral to the plot

review.pacing: The pacing is mostly good for the movie, but it does feel a bit slow at points and would have benefited from having ten to fifteen minutes shaved off
review.climax: The climax is a typical whodunit climax, and it is executed pretty well; The ending is very emotional and feels like a satisfying conclusion for the journey you take with these sheep
review.tone: The tone is very much that of a feel-good family whodunit
review.overall: Overall, "The Sheep Detectives" is a surprisingly well-made, feel-good family whodunit that is elevated by its strong writing, realistic CGI animals, and emotional core, making you care for these characters and their journey, especially the Winter Lamb
